name: Chuckles's Understudy
summary: A travelling jester is entirely sure he is the real Lord of Fools and has asked for a duel of jokes.

stages.journal: Barnaby Tuppence, in a hat of belled points, is certain he is the Lord of Fools and that the balloon is his understudy. He wants a witness to the contest.
stages.hint: Humour him, expose him, or find out who he really is.

stages.journal: Barnaby's claim is settled, one way or another. The crowd laughed in the right places for once.
We told Barnaby what he is. He took it badly and walked into the parade as a heckler.
